title: Sealed crustless sandwich
abstract: A sealed crustless sandwich providing a convenient sandwich without outer crust that can be stored for long periods without central filling leaking outwardly. The sandwich includes lower and upper bread portions, upper and lower fillings between them, a center filling sealed between the outer fillings, and a crimped edge along the outer perimeter sealing the fillings. Upper and lower fillings are preferably peanut butter; center filling is preferably jelly.
gist: This patent describes a crustless sandwich made by stacking two bread slices with fillings (typically peanut butter layers surrounding a jelly center), then using a specialized cutting cylinder to simultaneously cut out the crusts and crimp the bread edges together, creating an airtight seal that prevents leaking during extended storage.
